text: To David. Judge me, O Jehovah, for I went in mine integrity, and in Jehovah I trusted: I shall not waver.
Prove me, O Jehovah, and try me; refine my reins and my heart.
For thy mercy is before mine eyes, and I walked about in thy truth.
I sat not with men of vanity, and I will not go in with those lying hid.
I hated the convocation of those being evil, and with the unjust I will not sit.
I will wash my hands in cleanness, and I will surround thine altar, O Jehovah:
To hear with the voice of praise, and to recount all thy wonders.
O Jehovah, I loved the habitation of thy house, and the place of the dwelling of thine honor.
Thou wilt not gather my soul with the sinning, and my life with men of bloods:
Which in their hands mischief, and their right hand filled with gifts.
And I, I will go in mine integrity: redeem me and pity me.
My foot stood in straightness: in the convocations will I praise Jehovah.
